teams.title: Teams in the organization

load.title: Workload across all projects · Man-Days per week
load.over: {n, plural, one {Over capacity for {n} week} other {Over capacity for {n} weeks}}
load.hint: Includes every project in the Workspace · Red border = over capacity · Man-Days of tasks with multiple Devs are split equally · "Allocated to projects" = the hours entered in each project added up, compared with the person's total time. If it's over, it turns red and the Admin is notified

support.title: Support access from the Friday team
support.toggle: Allow the Friday team to access this Workspace to help solve problems
support.hint: Grant it in advance so the team doesn't have to ask every time · Every access must cite a Ticket number · Read-only for 60 minutes by default · Card data and passwords can't be seen · Owners and Admins are emailed every time access happens
support.ownerOnly: Only the Owner can turn this on / off
support.never: The Friday team has never accessed this Workspace
support.enabledToast: Support access granted · Recorded in the Audit log

audit.title: Audit Log
audit.hint: Entries can't be edited (append-only) · Exporting CSV is also recorded in the Audit log · Team plans keep 1 year · Enterprise keeps 7 years

data.title: Data storage and retention
data.regionHint: All Workspace data and files are stored in this region · There's only one region for now · When other regions open, only Enterprise can move
data.years: {n, plural, one {Delete after {n} year} other {Delete after {n} years}}
data.exportQueued: Export started · Download it here when it's done
data.typeExport: Request for a copy of data
data.handleExport: Send a copy of data of {email}
data.eraseHint: Removes the requester from the Workspace and anonymizes the account if they have no other Workspace · Can't be undone

data.completed: Request closed · Recorded in the Audit log
data.consent: Show a consent message when new users sign in for the first time
data.deleteHint: Deletes every project, task, file and member · Only the Owner can restore it within 30 days · The plan must be canceled first

templates.description: The same message as sent on each channel · Choose an event to see a preview
